audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the already-audited mirror. Ours read Skill / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Fiora / Fiora; the mirror moved the chart to the packet — Fiora rows 0-5, Swain at 2+ items.
audit.why: Swain wins only 44.97% here and the page's own early/mid text says Fiora dominates from the moment the wave meets and that levels 4-6 'do not flip this matchup' — the Skill tokens at rows 0, 3 and 4 contradicted the prose. Row 6 was the reverse error: whys[6] and late both call 2+ items Swain's stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 to Fiora and row 6 to Swain, as matched pairs, with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked cooldown on every line of this page and its number never appears. It is 24/22/20/18/16s — twice your Nevermove's 12s, which is what makes the bait plan viable. whys[3] and mid instead assert her Riposte cooldown 'is short enough to cover every trade cycle'.
audit.why: At 24s against a 12s root, the bait-and-punish window the page recommends is real and long; calling it short tells the reader not to bother.
audit.corrected: 24s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and whys[1]; Grand Challenge's 110s into spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every Riposte line implied she parries the outgoing E. Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass — so the parry window is the wave coming back, and because Riposte stuns when it blocks an immobilizing effect, eating your root with it is exactly what upgrades her stab to a stun. Separately, whys[4] and spikes[2].text claimed her vital damage 'cannot be healed through', which is false — true damage is reduced by nothing but it is healed like any other damage, and the real problem is her own healing off vitals and Grand Challenge.
audit.why: Riot's text: Swain E 'It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits'; Fiora W 'stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability'; Fiora R 'Fiora and her allies in the area are healed'.
audit.corrected: whys[1], wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now key off the return pass; whys[4] and spikes[2].text reframed onto her healing and Grievous Wounds. Lunge's on-hit application added to dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Your E root is online but Fiora's W Riposte animation-cancels it on reaction — she wins every trade you initiate and can stun you through a mistimed E.
edits.after: Your E is online but Nevermove roots on the return pass, so Riposte (24s) gets a second look at it — and parrying an immobilise upgrades her stab into a stun.

edits.before: W Riposte your E root or W slow on the moment of cast, absorbing your entire setup and stunning you in return
edits.after: Riposte the wave on its return pass, not the throw — blocking the root upgrades her stab into a stun

edits.before: Bait Riposte (W) with a throwaway W cast, then immediately land E-root and pull her into your Q burst
edits.after: Bait Riposte with a throwaway cast, then E so the wave's return pass roots her, and pull into Q burst

edits.before: Grand Challenge places vital markers on all four sides of you, and her percent-max-HP true damage proc from each vital ignores every Soul Fragment you have stacked and cannot be healed through.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four vitals and heals her whole side if she completes them, and the percent-max-HP procs scale off the Soul Fragments you stacked — anti-heal, not HP, is the answer.

edits.before: Fiora's Grand Challenge activates vital targets around you — her percent-max-HP true damage from vitals ignores your fragment-stacked health and R healing.
edits.after: Grand Challenge (110s at rank 1) marks four vitals and heals her and nearby allies if she completes them — get Grievous Wounds up first or the drain race is already lost.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1, and parrying your root upgrades her stab to a stun. Track it before every engage. - Your E: 12s, never on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 24s at rank 1. Parrying your root makes her stab a stun. Bait it first.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. When it is down — E-root + R her.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s and parries the wave's return pass — that is the half that roots her.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Her passive and R both heal — Grievous Wounds before any extended trade.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Lunge applies on-hit — her items land through it, so armour reads low.
